new_results.statement: Two positive source functionals whose baseline-weighted mean log frequencies bracket 30 GHz bound every finite absolute beta moment via Jensen and exponential tails. No compact beta prior is needed.
new_results.formula: M_k <= (k/(e a))^k J_minus + (k/(e b))^k J_plus, k>=1; M0 <= J_minus^(b/(a+b)) J_plus^(a/(a+b))

new_results.statement: Fixed-amplitude T->infinity defeats the original t and t^2 moment norm while finite-band intensities stay bounded; T->0 with beta=h*353GHz/(kT)-3 hides an increasingly large 353GHz peak from Haslam and DIRBE. These concern the unrestricted mathematical MBB class, not viable dust claims.
Positive row-normalized kernels and populated observations alone do not give a numerical global mass bound; an aggregate column-response lower bound suffices. No actual DIRBE/FIRAS hole is claimed.
